sections.heading: Bishop Heber College vs Kurinji College of Engineering & Technology for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Bishop Heber College if you want a recorded fee of ₹1.71 lakh, and an admission route through TANCET, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Tiruchirappalli.
Choose Kurinji College of Engineering & Technology if you want a recorded fee of ₹17,500, and an admission route through MAT, TANCET, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Tiruchirappalli.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹1.71 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA at Bishop Heber College. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹17,500 as a tuition figure for MBA at Kurinji College of Engineering & Technology. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Tamil Nadu. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you prefer a public MBA / PGDM campus and the reservation or fee pattern that often comes with it, Bishop Heber College is the better fit on our records.

Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Kurinji College of Engineering & Technology's recorded ₹17,500 or Bishop Heber College's ₹1.71 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
